name: JAG Berhad
overview: 2026年，JAG Berhad 通过全资子公司 JAG Renewable Energy Sdn. Bhd. 以 RM36,888,000 向 Kobe Steel, Ltd. 收购一幅位于 Shah Alam, Selangor 的约 15,016 平方米永久地契工业用地。金属回收与精炼板块方面，Jaring Metal Industries Sdn. Bhd. 与 Mitsubishi Materials Corporation 的谅解备忘录在年内多次状态更新中均无重大进展。公司同时多次公告以股息再投资计划等方式增发股份。
overview_en: In 2026, JAG Berhad, through its wholly-owned subsidiary JAG Renewable Energy Sdn. Bhd., entered into a SPA with Kobe Steel, Ltd. to acquire a piece of freehold industrial land measuring approximately 15,016 square metres in Shah Alam, Selangor for a total purchase price of RM36,888,000. In the metal recovery and refining segment, the MOU between Jaring Metal Industries Sdn. Bhd. and Mitsubishi Materials Corporation saw no material development in the multiple status updates during the year.

segments.note: 全资子公司 Jaring Metal Industries 与 Mitsubishi Materials Corporation 的谅解备忘录年内多次更新，均无重大进展。
segments.note_en: The MOU between wholly-owned subsidiary Jaring Metal Industries and Mitsubishi Materials Corporation was updated several times during the year, with no material development reported.
